targets.expr:
(
  sum by(service_name) (increase(aztec_tx_collector_txs_from_mempool_count{k8s_namespace_name="$namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[1m]))
  /
  (
    sum by(service_name) (increase(aztec_tx_collector_txs_from_mempool_count{k8s_namespace_name="$namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[1m]))
    +
    sum by(service_name) (increase(aztec_tx_collector_txs_from_p2p_count{k8s_namespace_name="$namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[1m]))
    +
    sum by(service_name) (increase(aztec_tx_collector_missing_txs_count{k8s_namespace_name="$namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[1m]))
  )
) * 100

(
  sum by(service_name) (increase(aztec_tx_collector_txs_from_p2p_count{k8s_namespace_name="$namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[1m]))
  /
  (
    sum by(service_name) (increase(aztec_tx_collector_txs_from_mempool_count{k8s_namespace_name="$namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[1m]))
    +
    sum by(service_name) (increase(aztec_tx_collector_txs_from_p2p_count{k8s_namespace_name="$namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[1m]))
    +
    sum by(service_name) (increase(aztec_tx_collector_missing_txs_count{k8s_namespace_name="$namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[1m]))
  )
) * 100

(
  sum by(service_name) (increase(aztec_tx_collector_missing_txs_count{k8s_namespace_name="$namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[1m]))
  /
  (
    sum by(service_name) (increase(aztec_tx_collector_txs_from_mempool_count{k8s_namespace_name="$namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[1m]))
    +
    sum by(service_name) (increase(aztec_tx_collector_txs_from_p2p_count{k8s_namespace_name="$namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[1m]))
    +
    sum by(service_name) (increase(aztec_tx_collector_missing_txs_count{k8s_namespace_name="$namespace", service_name="$service_name"}[1m]))
  )
) * 100
